theater: 歐俄戰線與西伯利亞鐵路走廊

battle.name: 俄國內戰
battle.theater: 歐俄戰線與西伯利亞鐵路走廊
battle.brief: 一九一八年五月捷克斯洛伐克軍團喺車里雅賓斯克嘩變，俄國全境自此爆發內戰。紅軍以鐵路為軸，用第五軍攻喀山，白軍靠哥薩克騎兵同裝甲列車反攻，拉鋸一路打到克里米亞。卡面呢挺莫辛-納甘M1891步槍係雙方步兵嘅標準槍械，烏拉爾同沃羅涅日戰線嘅火力骨架多由佢構成。

kit.name: 莫辛-納甘M1891步槍
kit.history: 1891年已列裝的栓式步槍，一次大戰同內戰都係紅軍同白軍的底子。內戰裡決定鐵路樞紐的係機槍、野砲同裝甲列車，唔係呢支槍的改型。

countries: 俄國內戰嘅交戰方大致分成紅、白兩個大營，中間夾住唔肯企硬嘅「綠軍」、各族人嘅地方武裝，同埋列強嘅干預部隊。紅軍一方以俄羅斯蘇維埃聯邦社會主義共和國為核心：一九一八年三月布列斯特和約之後，中央政府由彼得格勒遷回莫斯科，最高權力喺全俄蘇維埃中央執行委員會同人民委員會，列寧做人民委員會主席；軍權集中喺陸海軍人民委員部同最高軍事委員會，初期由托洛茨基兼任陸海軍人民委員，一九一九年五月再組建「國防委員會」做最高統帥機關。戰區編制上分為第五軍，負責斯維亞日斯克同喀山方向；第六軍，負責北面阿爾漢格爾斯克與穆爾曼斯克；第十二軍，沿烏拉爾到西伯利亞；第十三軍，負責察里津與沃羅涅日；第十四軍，對住南俄嘅鄧尼金；一九一九年十一月再拉起第一騎兵軍，由布瓊尼指揮。基層靠全俄軍事委員會、黨委同軍事委員一路貫通到連隊。白色一方冇統一政府，只有幾個各自為政嘅政權同軍團：一九一八年六月薩馬拉嘅「全俄制憲會議成員委員會」最早掛牌，同年九月改組為烏法會議，再變成鄂木斯克政府；一九一九年高爾察克自稱最高執政，掌第一軍、第二軍同西伯利亞哥薩克；南俄有鄧尼金嘅志願軍同其後沃蘭格爾嘅南俄軍；高加索有尤登尼奇嘅高加索軍；波羅的海方向有伯蒙德-阿瓦洛夫嘅西北軍同德軍支持嘅地方軍；西伯利亞同阿爾泰另有西部西伯利亞人民軍。干預方有英、法、日、美、加、中華民國等國部隊，加上人數最多嘅捷克斯洛伐克軍團，佢哋先後同紅、白兩邊都交過手。
countriesEn: The belligerents of the Russian Civil War fell into two large camps, red and white, with the uncommitted Green movement, the regional militias of the various peoples and the armed forces of the Entente squeezed in between them. On the red side the core was the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic: after the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk in March 1918 the central government moved from Petrograd back to Moscow, and supreme authority rested with the All-Russian Central Executive Committee and the Council of People's Commissars, with Lenin as chairman of the latter. Military power was concentrated in the People's Commissariat for Military and Naval Affairs and in the Supreme Military Council, the commissariat being held at first by Trotsky, and in May 1919 the Council of National Defence was created as the supreme command organ. By theatre the Red Army was divided into the 5th Army, responsible for Sviyazhsk and Kazan; the 6th Army, responsible for Arkhangelsk and Murmansk in the north; the 12th Army, along the Urals and Siberia; the 13th Army, responsible for Tsaritsyn and Voronezh; the 14th Army, facing Denikin in southern Russia; and from November 1919 the 1st Cavalry Army under Budyonny. At the bottom the chain of command ran through the All-Russian Military Commission, party committees and military commissars all the way down to company level. The white side had no single government, only a number of self-declared regimes and armies: the Committee of Members of the All-Russian Constituent Assembly was the first to raise its flag at Samara in June 1918, was reorganised in September into the Ufa Directory and then into the Omsk Government; in 1919 Kolchak proclaimed himself Supreme Ruler, commanding the 1st and 2nd Armies together with the Siberian Cossacks; in the south were Denikin's Volunteer Army and after him Wrangel's Army of Southern Russia; in the Caucasus, Yudenich's Army of the Caucasus; on the Baltic front, Bermondt-Avalov's North-West Army and the Landeswehr supported by Germany; and in Siberia and the Altai a separate People's Army of Western Siberia. The interventionists contributed British, French, Japanese, American, Canadian and Chinese contingents, together with the numerically largest of all, the Czechoslovak Legion, which at different times fought both the reds and the whites.
people: 紅軍一方嘅關鍵人物：列寧喺一九一七至一九一八年間逐步削弱反對派，建立起黨同蘇維埃嘅雙重領導，並喺布列斯特和約上為蘇俄換到喘息時間；托洛茨基以陸海軍人民委員身份搞出紅軍體制，推行軍事委員會、軍事委員同全體動員，令游擊隊變成正規軍；弗里茨接掌南方戰線同後來全軍總指揮，係消滅志願軍嘅主打人物；圖哈切夫斯基指揮第五軍攻喀山，之後打西線對波蘭人，一九二一年一度被自己人判罪，一九二三年獲赦免後赴中國任教；史達林當時喺察里津做黨代表，睇住呢個方向頂住反攻；波德沃伊斯基做過紅軍首任總指揮，後來主管軍訓同摩托化。內戰期間紅軍亦留低大批舊帝國軍出身嘅軍官，軍校同參謀體系就係靠佢哋撐住。白色一方：科爾尼洛夫由志願軍打崩紅軍，但一九一八年八月戰死喺馬蒙托夫附近；阿列克謝耶夫做過俄國軍總參謀長，試圖聯絡列強干預；高爾察克由中校躍升做最高執政，卻喺一九一九年東進之後崩解，佢嘅部隊被紅軍第一騎兵軍切斷退路，一九二〇年二月喺伊爾庫茨克被槍斃；卡佩爾係西伯利亞白軍名將；鄧尼金、尤登尼奇、沃蘭格爾分別代表南俄、高加索同克里米亞方向；薩溫科夫策動右派社會革命黨人喺一九一八年七月武裝起義，企圖推翻蘇維埃政府但失敗；捷爾任斯基掌契卡，以鎮壓手段對付所謂陰謀同徵糧糾察。一九一八年五月車里雅賓斯克爆發捷克斯洛伐克軍團嘩變，全體大會決定唔再同紅軍合作，軍團指揮官加伊達之後率部攻佔喀山。
peopleEn: On the red side the decisive figures were: Lenin, who between 1917 and 1918 gradually wore down his opponents, built the dual leadership of party and soviet, and bought the Soviet state breathing space with the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk; Trotsky, who as People's Commissar for Military and Naval Affairs built the Red Army out of the Military Commission, the military commissars and general mobilisation, turning a band of partisans into a regular army; Frunze, who took command of the Southern Front and later of the entire Red Army and was the man who destroyed the Volunteer Army; Tukhachevsky, who commanded the 5th Army at Kazan and later fought the Poles on the western front, was convicted by his own side in 1921 and was pardoned in 1923 before going to teach in China; Stalin, then the party representative at Tsaritsyn, watching that front absorb the counter-offensive; and Podvoisky, the first commander-in-chief of the Red Army, later in charge of training and motorisation. The Red Army also inherited a large body of officers from the old imperial army, and the academies and the staff system rested on their shoulders. On the white side: Kornilov, who broke the Red Army with the Volunteer Army but was killed in August 1918 near Mamontov's cavalry; Alekseyev, the former chief of the general staff who tried to enlist Entente intervention; Kolchak, who rose from lieutenant colonel to Supreme Ruler only to see his army disintegrate after the eastward drive of 1919, cut off from retreat by the Red Army's 1st Cavalry Army and shot at Irkutsk in February 1920; Kappel, the leading white commander in Siberia; Denikin, Yudenich and Wrangel, who respectively led the southern, Caucasian and Crimean fronts; Savinkov, who drove the armed rising of the Right Socialist-Revolutionaries in July 1918 in an attempt to overthrow the Soviet government and failed; and Dzerzhinsky, head of the Cheka, who used repression against so-called plots and against the food-requisition detachments. In May 1918 the Czechoslovak Legion mutinied at Chelyabinsk, its congress deciding to break with the reds, and the legion's commander Gajda later stormed Kazan.
kits: 卡面呢件莫辛-納甘M1891步槍，係俄國陸軍一八九一年定裝嘅栓動步槍：七點六二乘五四公釐口徑、五發固定彈倉，槍管長一〇二〇公厘，連刺刀座約重四公斤，標尺刻度可到兩千米，實戰常用有效射程約六百米，槍口初速約八百六十公尺每秒。一八九一年槍用五條膛線，一八九五年式改用三條膛線、瞄準較精確，內戰時期已經有相當數量，但主力仍然係五線舊槍。槍身用櫸木槍托，錐度鋼製準星同機械照門，槍機拉柄係直柄，冇德式槍嗰種大圓球。呢支槍之所以重要，唔在改型而在數量：帝國軍解散時倉庫留低大批莫辛-納甘，估計約三百萬支上下，紅軍再喺圖拉、伊熱夫斯克、塞維爾斯克等廠製造，內戰年頭總數以百萬計，步兵班排每人一支，喺陣地拉鋸同火線都靠佢壓住。內戰時期紅軍新兵素質參差，不少莫辛-納甘根本冇裝保險掣，槍掛喺腰帶上行軍就容易走火，彈藥亦極度匱乏，好多連係一支槍得一發子彈。真正支撐火力嘅係重火力：俄軍每連配一至兩挺索羅多夫架Maxim水冷式重機槍，另有熱奇基斯氣冷式輕機槍；白軍方面大量接收德製Schwarzlose機槍同Mauser手槍。火砲以七六公厘師屬野戰砲、七六公厘迫擊砲同攻城重砲為主，另有騎兵快速砲兵負責追擊。裝甲列車係兩邊爭奪鐵路樞紐嘅王牌，紅軍「熱列茲尼亞科夫」號一九一九年五月喺彼爾沃梅伊斯克打穿白軍封鎖線，白軍亦有自己的裝甲列車同裝甲汽車。俄國喺內戰期間根本冇坦克車，最早嘅MS-1要到一九三一年先出現，兩邊只可以用裝甲列車頂替。空中力量靠一九一八年十月十三日成立嘅紅軍航空隊，蘇維埃政府喺一九一八年十一月底進行第一次空襲；手榴彈有RGD-1915手柄式同F1防禦型，糧食同彈藥就靠鐵路、火車、雪橇同載重馬匹運。
kitsEn: The Mosin-Nagant M1891 on the card face was the bolt-action rifle adopted by the Russian army in 1891: a 7.62x54mmR rimfire cartridge, a five-round fixed magazine, a barrel of 1,020 mm, a weight of about four kilograms with the bayonet lug, sights graduated to two thousand metres, a practical effective range of roughly six hundred metres and a muzzle velocity near 860 metres per second. The 1891 pattern had five grooves, while the 1895 pattern switched to three grooves and was more accurate; enough of those were in service during the civil war, but the five-groove old rifle remained the backbone. The stock was beech, the sights a steel ramp and a mechanical rear sight, and the bolt handle was a straight bar without the big round knob of the German pattern. What mattered about this rifle was not any modification but sheer numbers: when the imperial army dissolved its depots held a large stock of Mosin-Nagants, estimated at around three million, and the reds manufactured more at the Tula, Izhevsk and Siversky plants, so that the total during the war years reached the millions; every man in an infantry squad carried one, and it was the rifle that held the line in both the prolonged firefight and the trench. The red recruits of the civil war were of mixed quality, many Mosin-Nagants had no safety fitted at all so that the rifle could fire itself while slung on the belt, and ammunition was so scarce that in some companies a single rifle was issued one round. What really carried the firepower was the heavy end: the Russian infantry company carried one or two Sokolov-mounted Maxim M1910 water-cooled heavy machine guns, with Hotchkiss gas-operated light machine guns alongside them, while the whites had taken over large quantities of German Schwarzlose machine guns and Mauser pistols. Artillery consisted mainly of 76 mm regimental field guns, 76 mm mortars and heavy siege pieces, with horse-drawn mobile artillery for pursuit. Armoured trains were the trump card of the struggle for railway junctions: the red armoured train Zheleznyakov broke through the white blockade at Pervomaysk in May 1919, and the whites fielded armoured trains and armoured cars of their own. Russia had no tanks at all during the civil war, the earliest MS-1 not appearing until 1931, so both sides had to make do with armoured trains. Air power rested on the Red Air Force, founded on 13 October 1918, which flew its first bombing raid at the end of November 1918; hand grenades came in the RGD-1915 stick pattern and the F1 defensive pattern, and food and ammunition were moved by railway train, sleigh, and draught horse.
tactics: 紅軍初期冇正規戰術，靠游擊同閃擊；一九一八年春夏連番受挫之後，轉做進攻型游擊，再轉為守勢，核心原則係集中兵力打一點，靠鐵路把部隊、彈藥、載重馬匹同糧食運到同一個樞紐。紅軍指揮員講過一句「鐵路就係戰略」，意思係要打就沿住鐵路打，因為喺呢條路上先有糧食、有列車、有源源不絕嘅補充兵。第五軍就係咁樣由莫斯科東面沿伏爾加河南岸推進，八月初夜渡斯維亞日斯克，再攻喀山；白軍隨即反守為攻，加伊達率捷克斯洛伐克軍團喺八月攻入喀山、進抵薩馬拉，一度逼紅軍放棄伏爾加河流域。守方靠土木工事、機槍陣同野砲封鎖道路，攻方用密集縱隊在火力下推進，傷亡極重。白色軍隊嘅戰術同紅軍唔同：以哥薩克騎兵為骨幹，偏好長距離縱深襲擊，企圖斷鐵路、燒糧倉、散播恐慌，例如一九一八年九月底至十一月初馬蒙托夫突擊塔姆波夫至薩拉托夫嘅鐵路，令兩側嘅徵糧隊同後方完全停頓；高爾察克一九一九年想用同一套辦法由西伯利亞打進中亞，但被紅軍第一騎兵軍喺伊爾蒂什河切斷退路，凍斃同餓斃極多。兩邊都靠裝甲列車做流動堡壘，奪鐵路樞紐時裝甲列車先行、車站守軍隨後接管；紅軍在後方用武裝工人大隊護路，並對「綠軍」同坦波夫一帶嘅農民游擊隊用清剿手段，內戰部隊、臨時法庭同鎮壓政策同時運作。通訊好差，命令多靠騎兵傳令同火車遞送，前線常出現各自行動、誤擊自己人嘅情況。莫辛-納甘喺呢套體系裏面只係骨架：真正決定攻守嘅係機槍火力、砲兵同騎兵，步槍嘅作用係喺機槍掩護下向前推進同守住陣地。
tacticsEn: The Red Army had no regular tactics at the outset and relied on partisan raiding and hit-and-run; after a run of setbacks in the spring and summer of 1918 it swung to offensive partisanship and then to a defensive posture, with the central principle of concentrating forces on a single point and using the railway to bring troops, ammunition, draught horses and food to the same junction. One red commander put it as the railway is the strategy, meaning that a battle had to be fought along the railway, because only there were there food, trains and a constant flow of replacements. The 5th Army advanced that way from east of Moscow along the south bank of the Volga, crossing the Sviyazhsk at night in early August and then striking at Kazan. The whites answered with a counter-offensive: Gajda's Czechoslovak Legion took Kazan in August and reached Samara, briefly driving the reds out of the Volga basin. The defenders relied on earthworks, machine-gun nests and field guns to seal the roads, while the attackers pushed dense columns forward under fire at very heavy cost. White doctrine differed from red: built around Cossack cavalry, it preferred long-range raids into the enemy's rear, aiming to cut railways, burn granaries and spread panic. In the campaign from late September to early November 1918 Mamontov struck the Tambov-Saratov railway, bringing the requisition columns and the whole rear of that front to a standstill. In 1919 Kolchak tried the same method, driving from Siberia towards Central Asia, but the Red 1st Cavalry Army cut his line of retreat at the Irtysh and his men froze and starved by the tens of thousands. Both sides used armoured trains as mobile fortresses, the train leading the assault on a railway junction and the station garrison taking over afterwards. Behind the lines the reds used armed workers' detachments to guard the railways and, against the Green movement and the peasant insurgents around Tambov, they used sweep-up operations, with internal troops, summary courts and repression all running at once. Communications were poor and orders were carried by mounted couriers and by train, so the front often saw disconnected action and friendly fire. Within this system the Mosin-Nagant was only the skeleton: machine-gun fire, artillery and cavalry decided attack and defence, and the rifle's job was to advance under covering fire and to hold the position once taken.
data: 步槍本身嘅數據：七點六二乘五四公釐口徑、五發彈倉、槍管一〇二〇公厘、槍重約四公斤、槍口初速約八百六十公尺每秒、有效射程約六百米、標尺可刻至兩千米。數量方面，帝國軍解散時庫存莫辛-納甘估計約三百萬支，紅軍兵工廠喺一九一八至二〇年間另製數十萬支，總量以百萬計。兵力方面，紅軍一九一八年初建制部隊仍以數萬計，到一九一八年底約一百五十萬，一九一九年底約三百萬，一九二〇年巔峰時官方報稱約五百三十萬；白軍人數最高亦只有數十萬，志願軍一九一八年底約十餘萬；列強干預兵力峰值約十餘萬人，當中捷克斯洛伐克軍團佔五至六萬，另有英國在北方同西伯利亞、法國在南部、日本在遠東、美國在海參崴，仲有加拿大同中國嘅藍軍。傷亡方面，紅軍作戰與非戰鬥死亡被估計一百萬至一百五十萬，白軍同盟軍武裝人員死亡數十萬，平民因戰鬥、饑荒同疾病死亡多被估計七百萬至一千萬；一九一八至二一年間斑疹傷寒喺俄境造成約一百三十萬人死亡，一九一八年冬天嘅流行性感冒亦造成大量死亡，確數無從查考。時間上，紅白主力對抗集中喺一九一八至一九二〇年，克里米亞殘局到一九二〇年十一月沃蘭格爾撤出為止，遠東最後嘅白軍政權喺一九二二年結束。具體戰役數字：喀山一九一八年八月五日被捷軍團攻陷，紅軍隨即反攻收復；彼得羅夫斯克與彼爾沃梅伊斯克一線喺一九一九年五月由「熱列茲尼亞科夫」號裝甲列車打穿；波蘭戰線一九二〇年八月十二至二十五日嘅華沙之戰以波蘭軍勝利告終；蘇聯喺一九二二年十二月三十日成立。以上傷亡同兵力數字多屬事後估算，學界口徑不一，引用時宜當作量級而非精確值。
dataEn: The rifle's own figures: 7.62x54mmR calibre, a five-round magazine, a 1,020 mm barrel, a weight of about four kilograms, a muzzle velocity near 860 metres per second, an effective range of roughly six hundred metres and sights graduated to two thousand metres. On quantities, the imperial depots held an estimated three million Mosin-Nagants when the army was disbanded, and the red factories turned out several hundred thousand more between 1918 and 1920, so the total ran into millions. On strength, the Red Army still numbered only tens of thousands of regular troops in early 1918, about one and a half million by the end of that year, around three million by the end of 1919, and officially some 5.3 million at its peak in 1920; the whites never exceeded a few hundred thousand, the Volunteer Army numbering a little over a hundred thousand by the end of 1918. Intervention troops peaked at a little over a hundred thousand men, of whom the Czechoslovak Legion accounted for fifty to sixty thousand, alongside the British in the north and in Siberia, the French in the south, the Japanese in the Far East, the Americans at Vladivostok, and the Canadian and Chinese Blue Army formations. On losses, red military and non-combat deaths are estimated at one to one and a half million, white and allied military deaths at several hundred thousand, and civilian deaths from fighting, famine and disease are commonly put at seven to ten million; the typhus epidemic of 1918 to 1921 killed an estimated 1.3 million in Russia, and the influenza winter of 1918 also killed a great many, with no reliable count. On timing, the main red-white contest was concentrated in 1918 to 1920, the Crimean endgame ran until Wrangel's departure in November 1920, and the last white regime in the Far East was extinguished in 1922. Specific engagement figures: Kazan was taken by the Czechoslovaks on 5 August 1918 and promptly retaken by the reds; the Petrovsk-Pervomaysk line was broken in May 1919 by the armoured train Zheleznyakov; the Battle of Warsaw on the Polish front, 12 to 25 August 1920, ended in a Polish victory; and the USSR was founded on 30 December 1922. These loss and strength figures are largely post-hoc estimates and scholarly accounts differ, so they should be read as orders of magnitude rather than exact values.
cause: 打成內戰，直接原因係一九一七年舊俄羅斯帝國喺二月革命同十月革命之後解體，國家權力出現真空，中央軍隊解散，地方督軍同舊貴族趁勢割據；布爾什維克喺彼得格勒奪權之後既冇足夠嘅軍隊亦冇穩定嘅糧食，於是十月革命之後「臨時政府」同蘇維埃並存，形成所謂兩個政權。內戰全面化有三個節點：一九一八年三月三日布列斯特和約，同德國停戰，政府遷回莫斯科，但蘇俄同白軍爭嘅係成個國家而唔係單一戰線；一九一八年五月捷克斯洛伐克軍團喺車里雅賓斯克嘩變，之後楚古、外貝加爾等地相繼起義，軍團同紅軍反目成仇，令全境分成敵對嘅兩大陣營；一九一八年七月六日左派社會革命黨人喺德國大使館暗殺德國大使米爾巴赫，之後蘇維埃自己宣布進入對蘇維埃國家嘅戰爭，白軍同反對派就多咗一個名正言順嘅旗號。深層原因有經濟同社會兩層：布爾什維克喺一九一八年三月嘅第四屆全俄蘇維埃大會推行戰時共產主義，又喺同年十一月嘅非常第六屆大會通過全國國有化法令，將糧食、運輸同大工業收歸國家，並組織武裝徵糧隊向鄉村攤派，結果引發廣泛嘅農民騷亂，坦波夫、楚瓦什一帶嘅抗徵鬥爭此起彼伏；白軍方面則以恢復秩序、保護地主同舊制度為號召，農民唔信任佢哋。加上協約國唔想布爾什維克喺俄國坐大，一九一八年五月英美聯軍喺阿爾漢格爾斯克同穆爾曼斯克登陸，同年日本海軍喺海參崴上岸，戰火同外來干預一齊將國家拖入全面內戰。
causeEn: The civil war came directly from the disintegration of the old Russian Empire after the February and October Revolutions of 1917, which left a vacuum of state power, dissolved the central army and let provincial governors and the old nobility carve up the country. Having seized power in Petrograd, the Bolsheviks had neither a sufficient army nor a stable food supply, so after October a Provisional Government and the soviets existed side by side, producing the so-called dual power. Three moments turned the civil war into a total war: the Treaty of Brest-Litovsk of 3 March 1918, which halted the fighting with Germany and brought the government back to Moscow, although the reds and the whites were now contesting the entire country rather than a single front; the mutiny of the Czechoslovak Legion at Chelyabinsk in May 1918, followed by risings at Chita and in Transbaikal, which turned the legion against the reds and split the country into two hostile camps; and the assassination of the German ambassador Mirbach by Left Socialist-Revolutionaries at the German embassy on 6 July 1918, after which the Soviet government itself proclaimed a war against the Soviet state, giving the whites and the opposition a legitimate-sounding banner. The deeper causes were economic and social. The Bolsheviks introduced war communism at the Fourth All-Russian Congress of Soviets in March 1918, and at the Extraordinary Sixth Congress in November of the same year passed the nationalisation decree, taking food, transport and large industry into state hands and sending armed requisition detachments into the villages; this triggered peasant unrest on a wide scale, with resistance to requisition flaring in Tambov and among the Chuvash. The whites, for their part, campaigned on restoring order and protecting landowners and the old system, which the peasants did not trust. And the Entente did not want the Bolsheviks to consolidate power in Russia: in May 1918 British and American forces landed at Arkhangelsk and Murmansk, and in the same year the Japanese navy landed at Vladivostok, so that war and foreign intervention together dragged the country into a total civil war.
impact: 最直接嘅後果係蘇維埃體制喺俄國存活落嚟，最終喺一九二二年十二月三十日組成蘇聯，並且一直行到一九九一年。軍隊上，紅軍由一支臨時性嘅武裝變成國家嘅核心機構，黨亦因此高度軍事化：大批黨員被編入軍隊，軍隊設黨委同政治委員，黨同槍之間嘅關係成為蘇聯政治嘅基本邏輯，亦成為一九三〇年代大清洗嘅背景——內戰同干預時期同外國人接觸過嘅軍隊知識份子被懷疑，圖哈切夫斯基等大批指揮官喺一九三七年被處決，蘇軍到一九四一年損失慘重，同呢段歷史直接相關。紅軍亦留低一批老兵骨幹，佢哋喺西班牙內戰、東線同德國戰爭時成為軍官團底子。經濟同人口代價極大：一九二一至二二年嘅饑荒死數百萬人，約上百萬白俄、支持舊制度嘅專業人士同農民流散海外，喺歐洲、美洲同亞洲建立僑民社區，影響至今。國際上，內戰結果確立咗蘇維埃俄國嘅邊界：芬蘭獨立，波蘭經里加條約取得大片西部土地，愛沙尼亞、拉脫維亞同立陶宛獨立，高加索出現亞美尼亞、阿塞拜疆同格魯吉亞三個國家，烏克蘭同中亞亦一度短暫獨立又歸入聯盟。共產國際喺一九一九年三月成立，內戰經驗亦變成蘇聯輸出革命同干涉別國內政嘅意識基礎。一九二〇年波蘭戰役同一九二二年日本撤出遠東，令蘇俄喺東方邊境長時間同資本世界對峙，蘇聯時期嘅中蘇關係同遠東問題亦由此開頭。
impactEn: The most direct consequence was that the Soviet order survived in Russia, was finally bundled into the USSR on 30 December 1922, and lasted until 1991. In military terms the Red Army turned from an improvised armed force into the core institution of the state, and the party itself became highly militarised: large numbers of party members were conscripted, the army got party committees and political commissars, and the bond between party and gun became the basic logic of Soviet politics, and the background to the purges of the 1930s. Military intellectuals who had dealt with foreigners during the civil war and the intervention were suspected, and commanders such as Tukhachevsky were shot in 1937; the catastrophic condition of the Red Army in 1941 is directly connected with this history. The Red Army also left behind a body of regular soldiers who became the backbone of the officer corps in Spain, on the Eastern Front and in the war against Germany. The economic and human cost was enormous: the famine of 1921 to 1922 killed several million, and of the order of a million whites, old-regime professionals and peasants scattered abroad, founding émigré communities in Europe, the Americas and Asia whose influence is still felt. Internationally, the outcome fixed the borders of Soviet Russia: Finland became independent, Poland acquired a large western territory under the Treaty of Riga, Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania became independent, three separate states appeared in the Caucasus, and Ukraine and Central Asia were briefly independent before being drawn into the Union. The Comintern was founded in March 1919, and the civil war experience became the ideological basis for Soviet revolution export and intervention in other countries' affairs. The Polish campaign of 1920 and the Japanese withdrawal from the Far East in 1922 left Soviet Russia facing the capitalist world along its eastern frontier for years, and the Soviet-era relationship with China and the Far East question begin in those years.
result: 結果係紅軍全面勝出。白色各方被逐一收拾：一九一八年八月科爾尼洛夫戰死，志願軍失去最能打嘅指揮者；一九一九年高爾察克嘅西伯利亞遠征失敗，佢嘅部隊被紅軍第一騎兵軍喺伊爾蒂什河切斷退路，一九二〇年二月佢喺伊爾庫茨克被處決；一九二〇年十一月鄧尼金嘅大軍喺諾沃羅西斯克附近崩潰，他本人流亡海外；同一個月底沃蘭格爾放棄克里米亞，數十萬白俄同軍人由克里米亞撤走，一部分經黑海去歐洲，一部分留喺中東；遠東最後一批白軍政權喺一九二二年被紅軍掃平，同年五月日軍撤出南西伯利亞。十月革命之後爭取到嘅政權，到一九二二年十二月三十日以蘇聯成立告一段落。但勝出代價好大：紅軍用緊糧食專制同鎮壓換咗戰爭勝利，戰後立即面對農民反彈，一九二一年三月嘅喀琅施塔得起義同全俄蘇維埃第十次代表大會上通過嘅新經濟政策，都係呢場戰爭嘅直接後果。白軍敗因亦幾清楚：幾個政府互不統一、缺乏統一戰線，兵力分散喺幾千公里長嘅鐵路沿線，過度依賴外國援助同舊帝國軍裝備，後方有大量游擊隊同「綠軍」扯後腿，最致命嗰條係白軍嘅土地同糧食政策令佢哋失去農民，而紅軍雖然窮困，至少仲有土地法令同對農民嘅承諾撐住基層。呢場戰爭嘅勝負唔係由莫辛-納甘步槍決定，係由鐵路、物資、騎兵同土地政策決定，而呢四樣嘢紅軍都佔先。
resultEn: The result was a complete red victory. The white forces were disposed of one by one: in August 1918 Kornilov was killed, costing the Volunteer Army its most capable commander; in 1919 Kolchak's Siberian drive failed, his troops cut off from retreat by the Red 1st Cavalry Army at the Irtysh, and in February 1920 he was executed at Irkutsk; in November 1920 Denikin's great army collapsed near Novorossiysk and he himself went into exile abroad; in the same month Wrangel abandoned the Crimea, tens of thousands of whites and their troops withdrawing by sea, some via the Black Sea to Europe and some remaining in the Middle East; the last white regime in the Far East was swept away by the reds in 1922, and in May of that year the Japanese withdrew from southern Siberia. The regime won in October 1917 was thus consolidated, and the story closed with the founding of the USSR on 30 December 1922. The cost of the victory was heavy: the reds had won the war with food dictatorship and repression, and immediately faced peasant reaction, with the Kronstadt rising of March 1921 and the New Economic Policy adopted at the Tenth All-Russian Congress of Soviets both direct consequences of this civil war. The reasons for white defeat are equally clear: several governments with no unity and no common front, forces strung out along thousands of kilometres of railway, excessive dependence on foreign aid and on imperial equipment, a rear area infested with partisans and Greens, and above all a land and grain policy that lost them the peasants, while the reds, poor as they were, at least had the land decree and their promises to the peasantry to hold the base. The outcome of this war was not decided by the Mosin-Nagant rifle but by the railway, by supplies, by cavalry and by land policy, and in all four the reds held the advantage.
